utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the twenty-second. Can you all hear me? We've got the usual lovely echo from the plant end.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, clear enough. Before we start, whose new car is that in the car park? It's taking up a fairly ambitious amount of space.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one held together by road dirt.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Someone's doing all right, then. Unlike the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Still dispensing disappointment.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Hot disappointment, or has that bit failed as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a vehicle survey—

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, last thing. The charity bake sale on Friday. Hopefully the cakes are better than the coffee. Not volunteering for anything, just saying.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Very carefully worded, Fiona.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Practised, I'd say. Right, what's already closed? Keep that separate from what we're agreeing this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Already swapped the filter on the waste heat boiler yesterday. That's done, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's behind us.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller on Tuesday. That can stay in the finished pile as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's the sign-off I was thinking of. Nothing outstanding from that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Finished the repair on the line one HPU last night, too. Just reporting completion there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, thanks, Grace. Access and parts blockers?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, can't get to the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit until production gives us a window. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Separate point from the repair I've just mentioned, yeah? Don't want those getting rolled into one.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. I'm not committing to getting in there today; we haven't got access.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'm still waiting on parts for the main isolation valve. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Both stay as blockers, not fresh jobs being handed out here.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: One observation as well: saw the pressure on the relief valve dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there. Came back without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Just passing on what I saw, not proposing another job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. Let's get onto the actual actions.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide, can you order spare parts for the Site Water System?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't take the ordering on, sorry. I haven't got the capacity for that as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, fair enough. Fiona, can you take that instead—order spare parts for the Site Water System?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that from Olumide. I'll order spare parts for the Site Water System.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's separate from my main isolation valve parts, just so we're not muddling the two.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, Site Water System ordering is mine. Your parts wait is still the blocker you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next, the risk assessment for work on the outfeed conveyor needs updating.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll update the risk assessment for work on the outfeed conveyor by end of day. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Is that the assessment for the work, rather than adding any physical conveyor work to this list?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. The risk assessment is what I'm taking. Not volunteering anyone for extra conveyor work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace. Urgent, by end of day. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Gas Turbine 2 by Thursday. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Thursday as in today, PR? Just checking, because my head's still somewhere around Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Today, yes. By Thursday, not next week. Important, but it isn't an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, PR. Permit to work and isolation for the Gas Turbine 2 with you.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right. I heard 'Gas Turbine 2' and nearly jumped in before you'd finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: You and half the microphone, yeah. But that's the scope I've taken.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 as well. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just the guarding check, Fiona, not agreeing alterations off the back of this call?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, checking the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1. No alterations being agreed here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fiona, that's yours. Not an emergency, but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: There's also the need to recalibrate the sensors on the boiler safety valve tomorrow at 9:30. That's marked low priority. I haven't got an owner for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Who can take that recalibration? Anyone able to commit?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't take it on, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, I can't commit to that either.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Not one I can take, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, nobody's taking it. Recalibrate the sensors on the boiler safety valve stays unassigned: tomorrow at 9:30, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And that time is the requested time, not us saying somebody's booked to do it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. It's needed, but there's no owner and no commitment to carrying it out.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: What I can take is the toolbox talk. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Where's that sitting priority-wise, Olumide?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Low priority. I'll organise it, but it's not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide. Toolbox talk organisation with you, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That all sounds right from my end. And nobody's accidentally given me the coffee machine, which is a relief.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Definitely not. That was a complaint, not a maintenance request.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: A very well-supported complaint.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything we've misunderstood in what's been agreed?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, clear here. Finished work separate, blockers separate.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Same here. All clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. We'll leave it there. Thanks, everyone.
